competition: International Mathematics Competition for University Students
scope_note: Bounded first edition: all 32 past year archive landing pages 1994–2025 inventoried; all 89 linked PDFs receive HTTP HEAD checks; only 2023–2025 questions and official solutions are downloaded and inspected. 2026 omitted.
source_provenance_policy: Downloaded official HTML/PDF bytes carry SHA-256 and retrieval time. HEAD checks are not body retrievals and have no document hash. Private research copies stay outside the repository.

rights.publication_policy: Links and original editorial metadata only; no third-party PDFs, problem statements, solution text, or compilations mirrored.

missing_coverage: 1994–2022 individual problem statements, subjects, prerequisites and difficulty not inspected or cataloged.
Individual counts for 1994–2014 not established here.
The mathematics in official solutions has not been independently proof-reviewed.
